## Site health monitor

**NOT imported into or tested on a running n8n instance.** Written from n8n documentation and source.

Every 30 minutes it checks a short list of paths on SITE_BASE_URL: HTTP 200, the indexing rules for the expected environment (SITE_EXPECTED_ENV: production pages must not be noindex, staging pages must be noindex in both the header and the meta tag, the staging robots.txt must block everything and staging must publish no sitemap), and that /api/v1/index.json is valid JSON for the expected environment. The API is noindex in every environment by design.

Alert rules follow packages/automation/src/monitoring.ts: alert after 2 failures in a row (evaluateUptime), any 5xx at once (evaluateVitals), no repeat for the same check within 60 minutes (shouldNotify). Indexing and environment mismatches also alert at once. Failure counts are kept in workflow static data, which n8n saves only for production (active) executions.

A staging site behind deployment protection will answer 401 or 403 and will alert. Monitor production, or an unprotected staging.

Environment variables: SITE_BASE_URL, SITE_EXPECTED_ENV, NOTIFY_FROM_ADDRESS, ALERT_NOTIFY_ADDRESS.
